request-prompt: Move the 'Related articles' links and other self-help links from the bottom and sidebar of the page into a highly visible 'Recommended Self-Help' block right below the main article header.
goal: I prefer to troubleshoot issues and configure settings entirely on my own using self-service help articles and documentation.
jobs: I want to learn how to enable or disable standard Fandom features (such as Message Wall, Article Comments, or Blogs) using the Admin Dashboard.
I want to submit a request to Fandom staff to turn on a restricted extension (such as custom JavaScript, achievements, DPL, or Variables) for my wiki.
I want to find where to request or set up an interlanguage link for my wiki.
I want to navigate to instructions for other wiki administration tasks, such as changing a wiki's name/URL or closing/reopening a wiki.
I want to contact Fandom support with custom questions about my wiki's features or configuration.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer using simple, built-in administrative dashboards and visual settings menus to manage my site rather than dealing with code.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer using advanced customization options like custom JavaScript, custom CSS, and complex extensions to fine-tune my site.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer to troubleshoot issues and configure settings entirely on my own using self-service help articles and documentation.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer reaching out to customer support or system administrators directly to handle configuration changes and setup tasks for me.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer concise, minimal help pages that provide a direct link or a single clear instruction to solve my immediate problem.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer highly detailed documentation with extensive context, definitions, and external references so I can fully understand the underlying system.

preference: I prefer to troubleshoot issues and configure settings entirely on my own using self-service help articles and documentation.
